en: A vintage, lightly colorized postcard view of traditional Dutch windmills standing along the edge of a calm body of water. Several large wooden windmills and adjacent barns or sheds line the waterfront under a pale sky. The scene is printed with captions in the lower margin, including the place name and a short description in what appears to be Dutch or German, as well as a publisher line and date.
